prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production candidate animation atlas for the 1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III prerendered battlefield, not a concept poster.
Input image 1 is ONLY identity, equipment and native painted rendering reference. Repaint this exact woman in bow actions. Keep her brown hair/hood, steel/leather, small fur cape, quiver, compact proportions and muted textures. Ordinary wooden bow and physical arrow, no crossbow, ice magic, glowing weapon, feathers or eagle.
Make exactly EIGHTEEN fully painted full-body poses in a regular SIX COLUMN by THREE ROW atlas, landscape 1536x1024, genuinely transparent background. Same woman, same height, fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera looking at her FRONT and LEFT SIDE as she faces SCREEN RIGHT, upper-left light. Feet stay at the same location within each cell, all limbs, bow tips and arrows contained inside the cell with large transparent gutters. No text, labels, frames, floor, ground painting or drop-shadow plate. Every pose must be a real newly articulated pose, not rotating a whole body. No duplicated frames.
Each row is one coherent SINGLE-arrow shot. Six phases left to right:
1. Begin nocking an arrow, bow lowered slightly but body already facing target.
2. Extend left bow arm toward target while right hand draws string with nocked arrow.
3. Full draw, right fingers touch cheek/jaw anchor, arrow aligned along target direction, bent upper bow limb and taut string form mechanically understandable bow anatomy.
4. FIRST RELEASE: arrow has just left, string nearly straight, right fingers open and draw hand follows back beside cheek, forward left hand still holding BOW GRIP and not holding arrow tip.
5. Follow-through, empty bow maintained toward the target, drawing hand relaxes.
6. Lower bow toward comfortable ready stance, feet unmoved.
ROW 1: SHOOT UP; during phases2,3,4,5 aim physical arrow distinctly UP and RIGHT, about +30 degrees above horizon. Bow itself is angled so its limbs are perpendicular to arrow axis, front bow hand raised above shoulder, draw shoulder and torso articulate naturally, head looks up along shaft.
ROW 2: SHOOT FRONT; during phases2,3,4,5 aim physical arrow HORIZONTALLY RIGHT at shoulder height, not angled up or down.
ROW 3: SHOOT DOWN; during phases2,3,4,5 aim physical arrow distinctly DOWN and RIGHT, about -30 degrees below horizon, bow hand lowered toward chest/waist, torso bends slightly at hips with upright head looking down along shaft. Legs remain planted; do NOT tilt or rotate entire body.
Both hands remain anatomically plausible and distinct from the bow limbs. EXACTLY two arms, two hands and two legs. Show actual bowstring under draw and released in phase4; a new arrow must NOT appear in follow-through phases5 and6. Phase4 may include one tiny separated arrow aligned with aim and inside safe margin, the native projectile is separate later. No long flight trails.
Original Heroes III painted/prerendered metal, cloth, skin and wood; small calm highlights, no anime, no modern mobile-game 3D gloss, no photoreal hero splash. This is a compact ordinary Freljord soldier, no Ashe costume. Preserve subject rendering, do not pixelate the master artificially. Fixed camera and equal body scale across all18 cells.
VETERAN ICE HUNTER: preserve the upgrade's larger pale-gray winter-fur shoulder mantle and cape, reinforced dull-steel shoulder plates and armored bodice, strengthened recurved wooden bow with pale bone/metal reinforced tips, fuller quiver and sturdier bracers. Distinctly better equipped than basic hunter, still practical and muted, no magical weapon.
